text_block_list.text:
On my day off, when I happened to stop by 
a park—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? My name? I'm Haru Urara!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara...? Oh, could you be Haru 
Urara-chan from Tracen Academy?

For some reason, Haru Urara had joined a 
parent and child who were unpacking their 
bento.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Wha, big sis, you're an Umamusume from 
Tracen Academy!? Awesome!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehh!? I'm amazing!? Am I really!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It's amazing!! Ehehehe!! We did it—!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh!? Trainer!! Wanna eat lunch 
together!?

Haru Urara noticed me and dragged me 
along, so we ended up sharing our boxed 
lunches together.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hafu~, that was delicious~! Thank you for 
the meal!
choice_data_list: Thank you very much for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
No need to thank me. After all, it's just 
my way of thanking you for playing with my 
kid.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! Round 7 of Look Over 
There still hasn't been settled yet!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
You promised we'd continue after eating! 
I'm gonna win the next one anyway, 
though~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's on! I'm definitely not gonna lose 
either!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll win every game of 
Rock-Paper-Scissors, and I'll shake my 
head super fast, too!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, you two look just like real 
siblings.

With her bright and charming personality, 
she seemed capable of befriending anyone 
in the blink of an eye.
